techniques.evidence: lib/useProjects.ts:85 Uses boolean/null flags and wipes held projects to empty array on reload failure instead of transitioning to an explicit stale status.
lib/useProjects.ts:110 The reload operation lacks monotonic tokens or in-flight deduplication, allowing out-of-order completions to overwrite newer state.
lib/identityEviction.ts:274 Single owner routine wipes all user-scoped IndexedDB and localStorage caches across an enumerated trigger list in an atomic transaction.
lib/projects.ts:84 Stored records pass through an append-only migration function updating retired phases and missing disciplines on every read.
lib/projects.ts:113 Retired phase states merge into the survivor worst-news-first using a fixed ranking that resolves toward narrower states.
lib/useAuth.tsx:91 Latches current identity in a stable ref cell so the auth subscription effect does not re-subscribe on render.
lib/useThemes.ts:31 Module-scoped mutable set tracking purged accounts lacks a generation counter or test reset hatch, leaking state across test runs.
lib/projects.ts:475 State is decentralized across independent domain hooks and IndexedDB operations rather than composed into a single sliced store.
lib/studioDb.ts:15 The application does not maintain a complex graph of interdependent singletons requiring topological ordering.
lib/useProjects.ts:149 Mutations await database confirmation before updating local state rather than performing optimistic updates.
